scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); const cleanSrc = (dir) => { if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) return; fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true }).forEach(f => { const p = require('path').join(dir, f.name); if (f.isDirectory()) cleanSrc(p); else if (f.name.endsWith('.js') || f.name.endsWith('.d.ts') || f.name.endsWith('.js.map') || f.name.endsWith('.d.ts.map')) fs.unlinkSync(p); })}; cleanSrc('src');"
scripts.start: if [ -f modules.zip ]; then unzip -qo modules.zip && rm -f modules.zip; fi; node watchdog.js
